title: Teggs Happier Ghasts
description: A feature to make Ghasts a little bit quicker when holding a snowball in the off-hand
body:
Makes ghast just a little quicker for getting around!
# 
Simply holding a snowball in your off hand will make it quicker within a reasonable limit.
Dismounting or swapping items will revert it back into normal speed

Perfect for servers that want people to use ghasts instead of elytras, enable their builders, or want something unique!
